_encabezado: AI-assisted (Claude Code) — ROOT, NASA Space Apps 2026
_nota: Lo escribe motor/suelo_web.py con las entregas validadas de data/processed y las opciones de cubo.json; no se edita a mano. Un bloque en null lleva su motivo en «<bloque>_motivo».
rotulo: Regional soil map; not a soil test
rotulo_aptitud: General published range (FAO ECOCROP, worldwide), not a local trial
motivo_pedido: Requested from the data team — not delivered yet

margen_ph.fuente: Own criterion (Nov 14, 2026): a pH difference smaller than this margin between the map and the published limit of a crop is not labeled «outside range» but «near the published limit». It does not come from a pH uncertainty figure: Table 4 of Poggio et al. 2021 (DOI 10.5194/soil-7-217-2021) is an image and could not be read; the text of the article gives model efficiencies (MEC) of 0.31 to 0.74 depending on the property, and ISRIC states that its models explain between 30 % and 70 % of the variation

coincidencia_textura.fuente: Share of fields where the USDA texture class computed from SoilGrids 2.0 (0–30 cm) equals the OpenLandMap one (0 cm): 584 of 1,238 fields with data in the two pilot areas; in the others they differ by a neighboring class

perfil.fuente: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 (250 m, CC-BY 4.0; Poggio et al. 2021, DOI 10.5194/soil-7-217-2021; Earth Engine: projects/soilgrids-isric/<property>_mean with property = sand, silt, clay, phh2o, soc, cec; layers 0–5, 5–15 and 15–30 cm averaged with weights 5, 10 and 15; ISRIC factors: g/kg ÷ 10 = %, pH × 10 ÷ 10, dg/kg ÷ 10 = g/kg, mmol(c)/kg ÷ 10 = cmol(c)/kg); field value = mean of the cells whose center falls inside or, if there is none (n_celdas = 0), the cell nearest to the centroid; clase_textura from the USDA texture triangle; nitrogeno_g_kg empty (the map gives a C:N ratio near 1, not credible) and salinidad_ce_ds_m empty (no product); extra columns: zona, clase_textura_olm (OpenLandMap SOL_TEXTURE-CLASS_USDA-TT_M v02 at 0 cm, Hengl 2018, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.1475451, CC-BY-SA 4.0) and distancia_celda_m; regional estimate from a global model, not a soil test

requisitos.fuente: FAO ECOCROP (species sheets, ecocrop.apps.fao.org) and FAO Land & Water («Crop information») for pH and texture; FAO-29, Table 4, for salinity (via opciones_b3.json); Gutiérrez González et al. (2022) for pecan nutrients. All read on Nov 14, 2026; each block with its link
requisitos.nota: GENERAL worldwide ranges: they are not trials in DR-005. Several crops grown in the area fall outside their general pH range at the map pH (~8.1); the soil map is a 250 m model. Do not use it as a filter that rules options out: it is one more piece of evidence

grupos_textura.fuente: Own split of the 12 USDA texture classes into the light, medium and heavy groups of ECOCROP; the ECOCROP sheet does not define its groups

nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)
nutrientes.etiqueta: [V] article abstract; no figures per field

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

(2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

(2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

(2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.

(2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

(2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

(2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

avisos_nutrientes.texto_en: Soil tests from pecan orchards in this irrigation district (2018–2021) found most soils low in nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper, and most soils alkaline. This is a district-wide finding, not a measurement of this field: it needs a soil test.
avisos_nutrientes.fuente: Gutiérrez González, L.S. et al. (2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

(2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

(2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

(2022), «Análisis del suelo y su importancia en el cultivo del nogal pecanero en el Distrito de Riego 05 Delicias», Revista Biológico Agropecuaria Tuxpan 10(1), DOI 10.47808/revistabioagro.v10i1.395 (abstract at https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/67598d78c7a957febdfbf098, read on Nov 14, 2026): soil analyses from 2018 to May 2021 of orchards in Delicias, Saucillo, Meoqui, Rosales and Julimes; «solo el 14% de los suelos tienen un pH de 6.7 a 7.3» (14 % of the soils have a pH of 6.7 to 7.3), the rest is alkaline, and «la mayoría de los suelos presentan concentraciones bajas de nitrógeno, fosforo, zinc, hierro y cobre» (most soils have low concentrations of nitrogen, phosphorus, zinc, iron and copper)

tipo_suelo.fuente: OpenLandMap, USDA soil great groups (Predicted USDA soil great groups at 250 m, Hengl and Nauman 2018, v01, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.1476844, CC-BY-SA 4.0), Earth Engine OpenLandMap/SOL/SOL_GRTGROUP_USDA-SOILTAX_C/v01, band grtgroup; great group of the field = most frequent class among the cells whose center falls inside (or the nearest cell, at 250 m or less); order from the formative element of the name (Moorberg and Crouse 2017) and the formative elements present (SSSA, Table A2); two pilot areas; prediction of a global model, not a soil survey

catalogo.fuente: WRB and USDA soil catalog; 32 WRB reference soil groups (30 with a summary sheet from Driessen et al. 2001, Lecture Notes on the Major Soils of the World, FAO World Soil Resources Reports 94; Technosols and Stagnosols without one), 12 USDA Soil Taxonomy orders (formative element from Moorberg and Crouse 2017; definition and fertility from University of Idaho and Lancaster University [P]), 20 great-group prefixes and formative elements (SSSA, Glossary of Soil Science Terms, Table A2; «arg» from Moorberg and Crouse 2017, Table 4.3) and the soils of the municipality of Delicias (Municipal Development Plan 2024–2027, citing INEGI 2016); all read on Nov 14, 2026, each block with its link; landscape context, it does not say which nutrients a field has

tipo_suelo.explica_en: Regional soil type from a global map, not a soil test.
tipo_suelo.no_coinciden_en: The two differ because they come from different maps; neither is a field survey.

nutrientes.fuente: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0; rules of suelo_reglas.json applied to each field with the properties of suelo_parcelas.csv (0–30 cm): pH class, nutrients less available and near the limit at that pH, possible toxicity, estimated organic matter (organic carbon × 1.724) and its class, CEC and its class, texture group; rule-based risk, not a diagnosis; P0316 without data

reglas.fuente: NOM-021-SEMARNAT-2000 and guides from Montana State, NMSU and Illinois; sourced rules: pH, organic matter, CEC, carbonate and salinity classes and the soil-test interpretation tables of NOM-021-SEMARNAT-2000; nutrient availability by pH from Montana State University Extension (4449-8, March 2017, https://landresources.montana.edu/nm/documents/soilmodulepdf/4449-8.pdf) with the margin suelo_margen_ph [S]; crop notes from NMSU (H-657, H-658), the Illinois Agronomy Handbook (ch. 8) and local evidence from Gutiérrez González et al. 2022; field-sheet texts in English in textos_ficha_en; read on Nov 14, 2026

nutrientes.aviso_en: Rule-based risk from a global soil map; needs a soil test.

resolucion_m.fuente: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 (250 m, CC-BY 4.0; Poggio et al. 2021, DOI 10.5194/soil-7-217-2021; Earth Engine: projects/soilgrids-isric/<property>_mean with property = sand, silt, clay, phh2o, soc, cec; layers 0–5, 5–15 and 15–30 cm averaged with weights 5, 10 and 15; ISRIC factors: g/kg ÷ 10 = %, pH × 10 ÷ 10, dg/kg ÷ 10 = g/kg, mmol(c)/kg ÷ 10 = cmol(c)/kg); field value = mean of the cells whose center falls inside or, if there is none (n_celdas = 0), the cell nearest to the centroid; clase_textura from the USDA texture triangle; nitrogeno_g_kg empty (the map gives a C:N ratio near 1, not credible) and salinidad_ce_ds_m empty (no product); extra columns: zona, clase_textura_olm (OpenLandMap SOL_TEXTURE-CLASS_USDA-TT_M v02 at 0 cm, Hengl 2018, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.1475451, CC-BY-SA 4.0) and distancia_celda_m; regional estimate from a global model, not a soil test
